BL-1530 — The three standing shell tests that drive swarm_handoff.sh with a git_handoff draft speak the two-call self-audit: test_rule_proposal.sh (case 04, and 03b's fixed 10 s drain deadline), test_handoff_state_dir_worktree_root.sh (case 01) and test_required_stages_ticket_lookup_collision.sh have been red on main since the AUDIT_REQUIRED landing of 2026-08-30 (44d2d42591) because each asserts a queue on the FIRST call, which now prints HANDOFF_NOT_QUEUED by design
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: swarm_handoff.bb is not edited and no audit bypass (env or fixture marker) is added - each test makes the identical second call the protocol requires, and asserts the first call's AUDIT…
BL-1530 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1530" (or "reject BL-1530 <reason>") to act.
